Check the highlighted fields Your purchase Property price £ The price you’re paying for the home. You’re buying Your only home As a first-time buyer An additional property First-time buyers have never owned a home, in the UK or anywhere else. Nothing you enter leaves your browser. Clear figures 02 — Your results Your LBTT LBTT to pay — Enter the price of the home to see the LBTT to pay. Share of the price— Rate on the top part— Price plus LBTT— Tax-free part of the price— An estimate for one person or a couple buying a whole home. It doesn’t cover shared ownership, companies or trusts, mixed-use property, or reliefs such as for buying several homes at once. You normally pay within 30 days of completion, usually through your solicitor. How your LBTT adds up LBTT is charged on each part of the price that falls in a band, like income tax. The Additional Dwelling Supplement is charged on the whole price. LBTT on each part of the price Part of the priceRateTax Enter the price to see the breakdown. What other buyers pay at this price The same price for someone buying their only home, a first-time buyer and someone buying an additional property. Your only home—— First-time buyer—— Additional property—— How was this calculated? Enter the price to see how the figures are worked out. An additional property costing £40,000 or more also pays the Additional Dwelling Supplement of 8% of the whole price. The total is rounded down to the pound.
